angle.text: Who will care for your pets if you cannot?

copy.text: Who will care for your pets if you cannot?

scenes.why: The hook is the guide's own title: the question it answers, as a person would put it.

copy.text: Arrange permitted home access and test it.
Create a record for each animal: identifying details, routine, behavior, vet and relevant care documents.
Discuss emergency veterinary contact, consent and payment arrangements directly with the clinic.
Keep an accessible alert and contact plan so someone knows pets are at home.

scenes.why: The guide's own checklist, the first sentence of each item, ticked in as it is read.
